actions.name: Toxtricified
actions.description:
Effect: If the user has an ATK, SPATK, or SPD beneficial Nature, they are always in their Amped Up Forme, and if they have a HP, DEF, SPDEF beneficial Nature, they are always in their Low Key Forme.

While in Amped Up Forme, the user's @Trait[electric] and @Trait[sonic] Attacks have -5% Accuracy, @Trait[recoil-1-12], and @Trait[priority-10], and deal 30% more damage. The user has Plus as a Connected Ability.

While in Low Key Forme, the user’s Attacks have +1 CRIT, +15% Accuracy, +30% EHR, and @Trait[flinch-15], and the user has +10% RES. The user has Minus as a Connected Ability.
